UserProfileDoc.title: UserProfileDoc
UserProfileDoc.description: Private student account profile and learning preferences scoped strictly to the authenticated owner.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the account owner.

displayName.description: Student public display name shown on leaderboards.

email.description: Private registered email address (isolated to owner-only reads).

dailyProblemGoal.description: Custom daily solved problem target (5 to 100).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the account profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest profile update.

GameScoreDoc.title: GameScoreDoc
GameScoreDoc.description: Per-user, per-game, per-day best score used for the Daily and Weekly leaderboards. Readable by any signed-in user. NOT zero-PII: exposes uid, displayName and age tier. Doc id is {uid}_{gameId}_{dateKey}; week is derived client-side from dateKey.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the player (visible to all signed-in users).

displayName.description: Public display name; must equal users/{uid}.displayName.

gameId.description: Canonical identifier of the game played.

tier.description: Age tier played (visible to all signed-in users).

accuracyPercent.description: Rounded accuracy or completion percentage (0 to 100).

dateKey.description: Local calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD); must be within server UTC day +/-1.

createdAt.description: Server time of the latest raise of this best score.

/users/{userId}.description: Owner-only private user profile document storing registered email, display name, tier, and daily problem goal.

/gameScores/{scoreId}.description: Best-of-day score per user/game. Signed-in read; create/raise only by an email-verified owner; owner delete for erasure.
